summary: The 8-K reports routine operational updates for AB Private Lending Fund, a closed-end fund. Item 3.02 discloses an unregistered sale of 2,060 Class I shares for $50,928.80 under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S to feeder vehicles, with pricing finalized June 18, 2026. Item 7.01 declares a $0.20 per share distribution for Class I shares payable July 31, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. Item 8.01 provides May 31, 2026 NAV per share of $24.72, aggregate NAV of ~$163.0M, and investment portfolio fair value of $372.3M. No special-situation catalyst is present.
